$description: Qentrah unified design system — brand identity, color tokens, typography, spacing, layout roles, and UI patterns for workspace, mobile, and marketing apps. Merged from Brand/bund/design-rules.json + docs/design-system.json.

clearSpace.preferredUse: Keep the mark centered with generous white space around all edges.
doNot: Do not stretch, skew, or rotate the mark.
Do not add shadows, gradients, textures, or decorative effects.
Do not place the mark over a busy image.
Do not add extra symbols inside the icon canvas.

identity.presence: Use the Qentrah mark as a calm primary identifier, not as decoration.
identity.voice: Restrained, spacious, precise. No decoration for decoration's sake.
identity.antiCopy: https://openai.com/brand/ — referenced for clear-space and mark-integrity discipline.
markRules: Use prescribed clear space. Let the mark breathe.
Use marks exactly as provided. Do not crop or alter.
Do not add unauthorized colors, effects, textures, or elements.
Do not imply endorsement or partnership unless explicitly approved.

color.$comment: All semantic tokens map to CSS custom properties in globals.css (:root = light, .dark = dark mode).

brandSurfaces.$comment: Rules for brand screens: sign-in, launch, onboarding, icon canvas.
brandSurfaces.signInScreen: White or near-white bg. Mark in #121212. No decorative color.
brandSurfaces.launchScreen: White bg. Mark centered in #121212. No gradient behind mark.
brandSurfaces.darkLaunch: #000000 bg. Mark in #FFFFFF. Same clear-space rules apply.
brandSurfaces.iconCanvas: #FFFFFF bg. Mark in #121212. Corner radius 230px (iOS rounded square).

statusColors.$comment: Kanban column headers, StatusPill, board dropzones.

priorityColors.$comment: Task priority pills on board cards and table rows.

fonts.sans: "Manrope", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.arabic: "Cairo", "Manrope", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.mono: "SF Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

conventions: section-eyebrow: text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-400
card-meta:       text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400
body-copy:       text-sm font-medium leading-6 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400
label-field:     text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-500

spacing.$comment: 4px base grid. Always use multiples of --space-* tokens. Never arbitrary px values.
spacing.philosophy: Vary spacing for rhythm. Identical padding everywhere is monotony. Tighter inside dense components, generous at page-section level.

shadows.$comment: Depth is expressed through border + background contrast, not box-shadow. Shadows are off by default.
exceptions: Dark-mode task board cards: shadow-sm dark:shadow-black/30 — used for separation from column bg.
Hovered task cards: hover:shadow-md — motion feedback only, not structural depth.

topBanner.use: Workspace status or alert banners above the topbar

grid.cardGrid: flex flex-wrap gap-4 (fluid width, not fixed columns)

roles.$comment: Surface hierarchy. Each role defines what it can contain. Nesting outside these rules is a design violation.

shell.description: App chrome: sidebar + topbar + scrollable content area.

sidebar.description: Collapsible left rail. Fixed height. Scrollable nav inside.

topbar.description: Fixed top bar, 64px. Breadcrumb, search, mode toggle.

contentArea.description: Scrollable main area. Holds AppPageShell which applies maxWidth + padding.

pageHeader.description: Eyebrow + title + subtitle + action slot. Always first inside contentArea.

section.description: Named content block. Rounded-2xl bordered card with title + optional actions row.
section.background: bg-white dark:bg-white/[0.02] border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.06] rounded-2xl p-5

card.description: Atomic content unit. Used in grids, boards, lists.
card.background: bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950/80 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.07] rounded-xl p-3.5 shadow-sm
card.rule: NEVER nest a card inside another card.

drawer.description: Right-edge slide panel for create/edit forms.

modal.description: Blocking overlay for confirmations and short focused forms only.
modal.rule: Modals are for confirmations and micro-forms (≤3 fields) only. Use drawer otherwise.

statusPill.description: Read-only status badge. Inline in tables, cards, headers.

emptyState.description: No-data placeholder. Centered icon + title + description + primary action.
emptyState.rule: Always provide a creation CTA where records can be created.

variants.default: bg-zinc-900 text-white hover:bg-black | dark: bg-white text-zinc-950
variants.outline: border border-zinc-200/80 bg-white text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-50 | dark: border-white/[0.06] bg-white/[0.02] text-zinc-300

button.radius: rounded-[8px] default | rounded-xl tall buttons | rounded-2xl hero CTAs
button.typography: text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest (primary) | text-xs font-semibold (secondary)

avatar.initials: First 2 words, first character each, uppercased

motion.philosophy: Ease out with exponential curves. No bounce or elastic. Never animate layout properties (width, height, padding, margin).
bans: Do not animate width, height, padding, or margin.
No auto-playing animations that cannot be paused.

accessibility.rtlSupport: All components use logical CSS properties (ps/pe, ms/me). Arabic locale switches to --font-arabic (Cairo).
aria: All icon-only buttons must have aria-label.
All form inputs must have <label> or aria-label.
Do not rely on logo/mark alone to communicate an action.

i18n.rule: All UI strings must come from useTranslations(). No hardcoded English strings in TSX except debug output.

antiPatterns.$comment: These patterns are banned across all Qentrah surfaces — workspace, mobile, and marketing.

banned.description: border-left or border-right > 1px as a colored accent on cards, alerts, list items. Rewrite with full borders, background tints, or leading icons.
background-clip:text + gradient fill. Decorative and meaningless. Use solid color with weight or size emphasis.
backdrop-blur decorative cards everywhere. Allowed only for specific overlays (e.g. 'coming soon' blurs).
Big number + small label + supporting stats + gradient accent. SaaS cliché. Forbidden.
Same-size icon + heading + text cards repeated endlessly. Vary scale, weight, and grouping.
Modals are for confirmations and micro-forms only (≤3 fields). Use drawer for anything longer.
A card inside a card. Always wrong. Use rows, inline data, or sub-headers.
Always use semantic tokens (--color-primary, etc.) or Tailwind classes. No raw hex in component files.
No shadows, gradients, textures, or extra symbols on or around the Qentrah logo/icon. Per brand/identity rules.
The Qentrah mark must only appear on clean, solid surfaces — white, near-white, or solid dark. Never over imagery.
